data.name: YTKACE
data.subtitle: YTKACE
data.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. No ads, background playback, video and audio downloads, SponsorBlock, Picture in Picture, player gestures and deep interface customization.
data.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.39.4 | YTKACE 1.1.1 | YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_21.39.4

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.39.4
• Liquid Glass on iOS 26 for the tab bar, top bar buttons, menus, sheets, player buttons and YTKACE popups
• Liquid Glass settings page with a toggle for each part
• Selected Tab Color for the tab text or the text and icon
• Added HLS mode in Playback Fix
• Added 5x speed in the speed menu
• Improved native share sheet

Fixed:
• Multiple scrubber dots on feed videos with a custom scrubber
• Direct downloads using an outdated client

YouTube 21.39.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_21.39.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

compatibility.notes: Tracks the official itzzace/ytkace releases. The published build follows the latest YouTube release and needs iOS 17 or newer; upstream also ships a separate iOS 16 IPA (YTKACE_<version>_YouTube_iOS16_<youtube>.ipa) on the same release page.
